description: Work inbox of a mid-level engineering manager at a B2B SaaS company. Receives a steady mix of internal team coordination, vendor and partner correspondence, customer escalations forwarded from support, recruiting pipeline updates, and routine operational noise like calendar invites, CI/CD alerts, and newsletter digests. Urgency spikes around sprint boundaries, quarterly planning, and whenever a production incident touches enterprise accounts. Most emails require a read-and-file or a short reply; a handful each week demand real action or escalation judgment.
